The woman riding in front of this man clearly had no actual disability, but alas, she was still entitled to a scooter. This woman was probably around 400-450 pounds. There were folds of her that spilled off the scooter and nearly touched the ground. This man and woman were complete polar opposites. I'm assuming from the visible age difference that this was probably a father and daughter, or maybe even a nurse and a patient. While the man was extremely soft spoken, to the point where every word he said seemed to strain him, everything that came out of this pigs mouth was an obnoxious scream. Now, none of this would bother me, if she hadn't been harassing this poor man constantly. She could tell it took a lot of effort for him to talk, and tried to make him talk even louder. She yelled at him over her shoulder, as far as her non existent neck would turn. The first time I ran in with them, I was in the food section, coming out to walk down the main aisle. Moving bowl of pudding:

Fuck the shitty, fat caregivers who can't handle their jobs because they're too focused on themselves.
